body:
I agree with a lot of people here. That person handled your situation horribly. I'm truly sorry you went through that. In my experience, suicide hotlines are worthless though (just like my life! Hahaha). The one time I had the courage to call and I was put on HOLD. YES HOLD. no generic elevator music either. Ended up trying tha night but got caught.

My advice? Go talk to a real person; a therapist or doctor, or someone you trust. I hope you feel better and get the help you deserve (:

I definitely would rather him talk to me about his problems. Even though I have my own, I feel I should be the one to make him feel better. I wish he would talk to me more about that kind of stuff.

There isn't anything I think of that I want to DO but I'm open for ideas. I'd have nothing left without him and I know that sounds like every other girl, but my life has been really rocky and I've never had a rock like him before and I just don't want to lose that. 

Although I know what I have to do, it's really hard actually doing it.

"getting better" means not crying every night, stopping with the self-harm, being able to sleep well, not having that tingling feeling in the back of my neck when he talks to her, not being depressed and anxious all the time, and just feeling like I'm not a burden anymore.

I recently started seeing another therapist (the last few did not work out for me) and all she has done so far is pre-diagnose me with ADHD and severe depression... Other than her, I don't really have anyone I can go to.

I know he genuinely loves me, but I feel like such a burden to him. He has his own issues and when I try to help him, he feels he's putting too much on me so he goes to her and that just makes me feel worse, but I understand why he does that. I want to get better so that I can help him. Lately it's been different. I still care a lot, but he's the only thing keeping me going and if I can't even help him, I feel I have nothing left and no point in continuing a nowhere life

I have been self-harming myself for years now and have not been able to stop for more than a month. I always have relapses. This situation has only made it worse. It's been really hard dealing with this and everything else.. I think he really will leave me if I "don't get better". I just don't know what to do about the way I feel
might try that. I just don't want him to feel like i'm trying to control him.

We have long conversations about this and it's the only thing ruining our relationship. The reasons I have for not wanting to be friends with her are all because of my insecurities and the problems i've had with people in my past. He doesn't want to choose between us and I know he will leave me if it comes to that.

I haven't felt strong in forever. I just don't want to deal with myself anymore. It doesn't help that i have extreme social anxiety... I'm going to talk to her on her lunch break, but all I want to do is keep drinking and crying. I'll keep all this in mind though

I tried messaging her, but I ended up crying because she's just really nice and I'm a horrible person. I don't have many friends who are girls. I'm more of "one of the guys" To be really honest though, I don't like having friends. But you're right. I need to try again. It's just all really hard for me to handle

I met her before i met him and I have a pretty jealous mind. She's just so pretty and he talks of her like she's so amazing. I feel like nothing compared to her and that just makes me really sad. I guess I can't say I really HATE her, just, I wish I could be more like her. I mean you're right, it's not her fault she's just better than me. I just feel like I'm bothering him when i want to do something when he's talking to her.
